name: George Adeyemi
role: Founder and CEO of a nine-person logistics start-up, also the one who signs the cards.
context: He is replacing a shared document folder. He has twenty minutes between investor calls and will forward the page to his head of operations if it passes.
daily_tasks: Sells, hires, reads dashboards, signs spend over fifty dollars. He judges vendors by how clearly they say what they do.
fears: Wasting time on a vendor that does not answer; jargon he cannot repeat to his team; a sales call forced on him just to learn the price.
never_reads: Pricing footnotes and terms; the footer; documentation.
decides_by: He reads the top of the home page for the one sentence he could say aloud. If it does not make sense in ten seconds he leaves. Then he looks for a plan for ten people and a way to start today.
stake_rules: Secondary on a product page: he approves and pays, his team uses it. Primary on the signup and pricing path he would complete himself. Bystander on a technical page.
